content.value_statement: Starting a Google ADK agent project requires several template, deployment, and workflow choices. This skill guides agents-cli scaffolding from prototype setup through enhancement and upgrade planning.
actual_capabilities: Maps project requirements to agents-cli scaffold create, enhance, and upgrade workflows.
Explains ADK template choices, including adk, adk_a2a, and agentic_rag.
Compares deployment targets for Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE, and no deployment.
Guides prototype-first setup before adding Terraform, CI/CD, or deployment files.
Documents create and enhance flags for regions, datastore, sessions, and guidance files.
Highlights project naming rules and agent directory checks before scaffolding.
limitations: Requires agents-cli and uv to be available before CLI commands can run.
Does not write ADK agent code; a separate ADK coding skill covers implementation.
Does not perform production deployment operations by itself.
Cannot verify Google Cloud permissions, quotas, or billing state without local checks.

use_cases.title: Start a Prototype Agent
use_cases.description: Create a new Google ADK project with the right template and minimal deployment overhead.

use_cases.title: Add Deployment Scaffolding
use_cases.description: Enhance an existing project with deployment files or CI/CD choices after the prototype works.

use_cases.title: Plan RAG or A2A Architecture
use_cases.description: Choose the correct scaffold template, datastore, session model, and deployment target before coding.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Prototype
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prototype Google ADK agent project for [purpose]. Ask me for missing requirements before choosing a template or deployment option.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance an Existing Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance my existing ADK project in [path] with [deployment target or CI/CD runner]. Check the agent directory first and explain changes before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Scaffold
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a RAG agent scaffold using [document source] and [datastore preference]. Recommend the agents-cli template, datastore, session storage, and region choices.

prompt_templates.title: Upgrade Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Upgrade this agents-cli scaffolded project and preserve custom files. Use dry-run first, summarize conflicts, and ask before applying changes.

output_examples.input: Start a prototype customer support agent on Google ADK.
output: The assistant asks for the agent goal, tools, data sources, and deployment preference.
It recommends a prototype-first scaffold and explains which template fits the support workflow.
It confirms the project name and guidance filename before any local changes are made.

output_examples.input: Add Cloud Run deployment scaffolding to my existing project.
output: The assistant checks where the agent code lives and confirms the target deployment choice.
It explains the files likely to be added or updated, including deployment and build assets.
It asks for approval before running scaffold enhancement steps.

output_examples.input: Plan a RAG agent that searches internal documents.
output: The assistant compares document search and vector search options for the datastore.
It recommends a RAG scaffold path with region and session considerations.
It notes that datastore provisioning and ingestion are needed before meaningful tests.

best_practices: Clarify the agent goal, tools, data sources, and deployment needs before creating a project.
Start with prototype mode, then add deployment or CI/CD after the agent behavior is validated.
Confirm the existing agent directory and selected runner before enhancing a project.
anti_patterns: Do not create the project directory before running scaffold create.
Do not change an existing model choice unless the user explicitly asks.
Do not write A2A API wiring manually when the A2A scaffold can generate it.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps scaffold Google ADK agent projects with agents-cli, including prototypes, deployment files, and CI/CD options.

faq.question: Does this skill install agents-cli automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can explain the required installation command, but the user should approve any installation step.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it deploy my agent to production?
faq.answer: It focuses on scaffolding deployment assets. Production deployment operations should use the dedicated deploy workflow.

faq.question: Can it update an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers enhance and upgrade workflows, including dry-run review and conflict handling.

faq.question: Does it write the agent business logic?
faq.answer: No. It points to the ADK coding workflow for implementing agent instructions, tools, and models.
